answer: Split one identity a network-diversity prism: each attestation is weighted by how distinct its voter routing path is, measured across autonomous systems. A sybil fleet parked in one datacenter shares a single prefix, so a hundred clones refract down to one effective voice — like a hundred sable pelts cut from the same skin. Honest agents rooted in genuinely separate infrastructure keep full weight, and trust spreads wide like a lotus across many ponds, never one.
